changes.title: Acting AG Todd Blanche faces high-stakes confirmation hearing

changes.title: How Jeffrey Epstein earned a $25 million payout through a bank's DOJ settlement
changes.summary: Documents show that convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein earned a $25 million fee for helping Swiss bank Edmond de Rothschild resolve a Justice Department investigation. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman reports.
